description: The tourist or short-term business visa requirements for a destination, from the table Mira reads: documents, processing time, fees and the official page they come from (source). For a Schengen state, documentNeeds marks each document required of every applicant or depends, with when naming the situation, from that state's own pages (documentSources says whose list and for which place of application): tell the person which documents everyone brings and which depend on them, and that the consulate where they apply may ask for more. They are general, not checked against a nationality: whether the person needs a visa at all is visarun_check_eligibility's answer. What a given application asks is in visarun_get_application_fields.

country.description: The destination, a name or ISO code
